_extraction_flags.notes: BORDERLINE FOR EXCLUSION: Paper mentions 'ISAC-OF' as motivation but demonstrates ONLY vibration sensing. No communication experiment. Claims sensing is 'ideal for ISAC-OF' but does not implement communication. Similar to O_ISAC_007 pattern.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: Vibration demodulation flowchart (sensing only). Fig.4: OFDR system with PZT for vibration. Fig.5-8: Pearson-CC based vibration detection results at 100+ km. NO communication diagrams.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: OFDR-based Distributed Vibration Sensor (DOFVS) using Pearson-CC and PELT algorithm. The abstract says 'DOFVS is an ideal technology for integrated sensing and communication in an optical fiber (ISAC-OF)'. However, the paper ONLY demonstrates sensing - no communication waveform, no BER, no data rate. Similar to O_ISAC_007 (sensing-only exclusion candidate).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Sensing: 100.9 km range, 15.3 m spatial resolution, 868 pε strain resolution. Multiple vibration events detected. Communication: NOT DEMONSTRATED. Paper references ISAC-OF future potential but does not implement it.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: EXCLUSION RECOMMENDED: This is a pure sensing paper that mentions 'ISAC-OF' as motivation but does not demonstrate any communication functionality. Including it would dilute the O-ISAC corpus with sensing-only papers. Same pattern as O_ISAC_007.

bibliographic.title: Single-Ended >100-km Distributed Vibration Sensor Based on OFDR Using Pearson Correlation Coefficient
bibliographic.authors: Haohan Guo, Kun Liu, Yuanyao Li, Ji Liu, Huafang Wang, Jinqi Deng, Junfeng Jiang, Tiegen Liu, Zhenyang Ding

application.scenario_description: Ultra-long distributed vibration sensing for ocean cables, pipelines, and perimeter intrusion detection.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Single-ended OFDR vibration sensing using Pearson-CC and PELT algorithm, achieving >100 km range without optical amplifiers.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Existing long-distance DOFVS require amplifiers or dual-ended configurations, incompatible with ISAC-OF networks.

transmitter.notes: Silicon photonic chip laser, <1 kHz linewidth, ~8 mW. Internal modulation via AWG-controlled temperature tuning.

receiver.notes: Rayleigh backscatter coherent detection via MZI. DAQ at 200 MS/s, 16 MS samples.

integration.notes: NO COMMUNICATION FUNCTIONALITY DEMONSTRATED. Paper mentions ISAC-OF as potential application only.

waveform.notes: OFDR sweep at 84 GHz/s. No communication waveform.

channel_wireless.notes: 100.9 km single-mode fiber (SMF). No optical amplifiers. Two PZTs at 100.9 km and 101.8 km for vibration excitation.

sensing_metrics.notes: Spatial resolution 15.3 m (N=1000 window). Strain resolution 868 pε. R² = 0.9993 for amplitude calibration. Multiple simultaneous events detected.

tradeoff.notes: No ISAC trade-off analyzed - sensing-only paper.
